cards.title: Accommodation Options
cards.desc: Choose from a carefully selected range of accommodation to suit your group — from stylish city hotels to boutique countryside retreats, all chosen for comfort, convenience, and local charm.

cards.title: Local Cuisine
cards.desc: Start each day with a delicious, energising breakfast, and enjoy tailored options for group lunches and dinners featuring authentic Spanish flavours and healthy choices.

cards.title: Group Padel Lessons

cards.title: Organized Padel Play
cards.desc: Plenty of court time for friendly matches, round-robin tournaments, and social Padel sessions.

cards.title: Team Building Activities

readyTeam.description: Our Padel team building trips are designed to deliver results and create unforgettable memories. While we offer fantastic packages, we're also experts at tailoring every detail to your team's specific goals, budget, and preferences.

chooseActivities.subtitle: Every school group is different, so we design each trip around your goals and interests. Mix and match from our wide range of activities to create the perfect balance of sport, culture, and fun for your students.
chooseActivities.note: You decide what to include — we'll build the ideal itinerary for your group.

items.title: Padel
items.description: Daily padel classes suitable for all levels. Sessions can be tailored to your group's needs, focusing on different aspects of the game in a fun and engaging way. We can also arrange matches and tournaments with local players.

items.title: Other Sports
items.description: While padel is our specialty, we also create tailored programs across a wide range of sports including tennis, football, golf, swimming, hockey, and more. We can also arrange matches against local teams for a competitive and fun experience.

items.title: Outdoor Activities
items.description: From cycling and hiking to kayaking and other watersports, we can organise a variety of outdoor adventures for every interest and skill level.

items.title: Spanish Language Classes
items.description: Interactive Spanish lessons for all levels, designed to boost speaking confidence and fluency in a dynamic, supportive environment.

items.title: Spanish Cooking Workshops
items.description: Get hands-on and cook like a local! Learn to make authentic Spanish dishes, from tapas and paella to traditional desserts, guided by expert chefs. Taste your creations and experience the flavors of Spain in a fun, interactive setting.

items.title: Cultural Experiences
items.description: Dive into Spain's vibrant culture! Explore historic cities on guided walking tours, experience the passion of live flamenco shows in Sevilla, join interactive flamenco dance classes with a live band, and savor the best local flavors on tapas tasting tours

items.title: Local Professional Sports
items.description: Exclusive stadium tours and live matches with top local teams, including Barcelona FC and Sevilla FC.

items.title: Accommodation & Meals
items.description: Comfortable, student-friendly accommodation with flexible full or half board options, designed for a stress-free and enjoyable stay.

destinations.title: Destinations
destinations.barcelonaDesc: A vibrant Mediterranean city where modern energy meets cultural treasures. From Gaudí's spectacular architecture to lively beaches and youth-friendly neighbourhoods, Barcelona offers the perfect mix of learning and fun.
destinations.sevilleDesc: A city full of history and charm, perfect for students to experience authentic Spain. Explore its stunning monuments, discover the passion of flamenco, and soak up the city's famous tapas culture.
